scenarios.name: Valid verified account
scenarios.expected: Login succeeds only after account has been registered and verified in this app process.

scenarios.name: Unknown account
scenarios.expected: Rejected: account must be registered first.

scenarios.name: Wrong password
scenarios.expected: Rejected with invalid email/username or password message.

scenarios.name: Unverified account
scenarios.expected: Rejected until simulated verification is completed.

scenarios.name: Whitespace around email
scenarios.expected: Repository trims and lowercases identifier before lookup.
